- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.25) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for 30-day horizon.
- Underestimate during strong negative sentiment (sentiment < 0.10) — add 3–7% to forecast to account for volatility.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below true peak for 5–7 days post-spike.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 1–3% per day until convergence.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment rises sharply 3–5 days before forecast, adjust forecast upward by 1–3% to reflect momentum.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate in early 2025 (post-2024) — apply 2–5% downward bias if sentiment is neutral or mildly bullish.
